auth_identities_provider_subject_check.name: auth_identities_provider_subject_check
auth_identities_provider_subject_check.value: ("auth_identities"."provider" = 'password' AND "auth_identities"."provider_subject" IS NULL) OR ("auth_identities"."provider" = 'google' AND "auth_identities"."provider_subject" IS NOT NULL AND length("auth_identities"."provider_subject") > 0)

auth_identities_password_hash_check.name: auth_identities_password_hash_check
auth_identities_password_hash_check.value: ("auth_identities"."provider" = 'password' AND "auth_identities"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL) OR ("auth_identities"."provider" = 'google' AND "auth_identities"."password_hash" IS NULL)

auth_oidc_flows_hashes_check.name: auth_oidc_flows_hashes_check
auth_oidc_flows_hashes_check.value: "auth_oidc_flows"."flow_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "auth_oidc_flows"."state_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "auth_oidc_flows"."nonce_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND ("auth_oidc_flows"."session_token_hash" IS NULL OR "auth_oidc_flows"."session_token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

auth_oidc_flows_mode_owner_check.name: auth_oidc_flows_mode_owner_check
auth_oidc_flows_mode_owner_check.value: ("auth_oidc_flows"."mode" = 'login' AND "auth_oidc_flows"."user_id" IS NULL AND "auth_oidc_flows"."session_token_hash" IS NULL) OR ("auth_oidc_flows"."mode" = 'link' AND "auth_oidc_flows"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_oidc_flows"."session_token_hash" IS NOT NULL)

auth_password_login_limits_budget_check.name: auth_password_login_limits_budget_check
auth_password_login_limits_budget_check.value:
"auth_password_login_limits"."attempt_count" >= 0
      AND coalesce(array_ndims("auth_password_login_limits"."pending_attempts"), 1) = 1
      AND coalesce(array_lower("auth_password_login_limits"."pending_attempts", 1), 1) = 1
      AND array_position("auth_password_login_limits"."pending_attempts", NULL) IS NULL
      AND (("auth_password_login_limits"."subject_kind" = 'client_address' AND "auth_password_login_limits"."attempt_count" <= 100 AND cardinality("auth_password_login_limits"."pending_attempts") = 0)
        OR ("auth_password_login_limits"."subject_kind" = 'identifier_client_address' AND "auth_password_login_limits"."attempt_count" + cardinality("auth_password_login_limits"."pending_attempts") <= 10))

auth_signup_attempts_proof_check.name: auth_signup_attempts_proof_check
auth_signup_attempts_proof_check.value:
("auth_signup_attempts"."proof_hash" IS NULL AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_key_id" IS NULL AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_issued_at" IS NULL AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_expires_at" IS NULL AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_consumed_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("auth_signup_attempts"."proof_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_key_id" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_issued_at" IS NOT NULL AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_key_id" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{16}$'
      AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_issued_at" >= "auth_signup_attempts"."created_at" AND "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_expires_at" = "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_issued_at" + interval '30 minutes'
      AND ("auth_signup_attempts"."proof_consumed_at" IS NULL OR "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_consumed_at" >= "auth_signup_attempts"."proof_issued_at"))

auth_signup_codes_time_check.name: auth_signup_codes_time_check
auth_signup_codes_time_check.value:
"auth_signup_codes"."expires_at" = "auth_signup_codes"."created_at" + interval '10 minutes' AND "auth_signup_codes"."resend_available_at" >= "auth_signup_codes"."created_at" + interval '1 minute'
    AND ("auth_signup_codes"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR "auth_signup_codes"."revoked_at" >= "auth_signup_codes"."created_at")
    AND ("auth_signup_codes"."verified_at" IS NULL OR ("auth_signup_codes"."verified_at" >= "auth_signup_codes"."created_at" AND "auth_signup_codes"."verified_at" < "auth_signup_codes"."expires_at" AND "auth_signup_codes"."revoked_at" IS NULL))

email_outbox_retired_signup_index.name: email_outbox_retired_signup_index
email_outbox_retired_signup_index.where: "email_outbox"."source_kind" = 'signup_code' AND "email_outbox"."signup_code_id" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."provider_message_id" IS NULL AND "email_outbox"."status" <> 'pending'

email_outbox_signup_redaction_index.name: email_outbox_signup_redaction_index
email_outbox_signup_redaction_index.where: "email_outbox"."source_kind" = 'signup_code' AND "email_outbox"."status" <> 'pending' AND ("email_outbox"."payload_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "email_outbox"."token_key_id" IS NOT NULL)

email_outbox_source_check.name: email_outbox_source_check
email_outbox_source_check.value:
("email_outbox"."source_kind" = 'auth_token' AND "email_outbox"."token_id" IS NOT NULL AND "email_outbox"."signup_code_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("email_outbox"."source_kind" = 'signup_code' AND "email_outbox"."token_id" IS NULL AND ("email_outbox"."signup_code_id" IS NOT NULL OR "email_outbox"."status" <> 'pending'))
